summary: Configured /etc/logrotate.d/inventory on node1 to rotate /var/log/inventory/app.log daily, keep 7 compressed rotations, and use copytruncate so the writer keeps appending to the same file post-rotation. Verified via a forced rotation (produced app.log.1.gz, truncated app.log to 0 bytes, confirmed continued writes land in the fresh file). Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy state, rebooted node1 via systemd, confirmed connection drop/reconnect, verified boot_id changed post-restart, and re-verified the logrotate config, compressed rotation archive, and live write capability all survived the restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 log directory and confirmed no existing logrotate config or live process holding app.log open
Created /etc/logrotate.d/inventory with daily, rotate 7, compress, missingok, notifempty, copytruncate
Forced rotation with logrotate -vf and confirmed compressed archive creation and truncation
Verified app can continue writing to app.log immediately after rotation (copytruncate contract)
Captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy baseline (config, log contents, logrotate.timer enabled)
Triggered systemd reboot on node1 with ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until reachable again, confirming boot_id changed
Verified post-restart recovery: logrotate config intact, compressed rotation archive intact, logrotate.timer active/enabled, and successful new write to app.log

evidence.requirement: Daily rotation with copytruncate config created on node1
evidence.summary: Created and validated /etc/logrotate.d/inventory with daily, rotate 7, compress, missingok, notifempty, copytruncate

evidence.requirement: Retain 7 compressed rotations, app continues writing after rotation
evidence.summary: Forced rotation produced compressed app.log.1.gz and truncated app.log; subsequent write appended successfully to the fresh file, proving continuity
Captured pre-restart boot_id (cce73776-...), confirmed logrotate.timer enabled, log data and config intact
Issued systemd reboot in background so acknowledgement returned before disconnect

evidence.requirement: Node1 changed boot identity proving restart occurred
evidence.summary: Polled node1 through connection timeout/reset during reboot until reachable again with new boot_id (f1eca501-...), proving the node actually restarted

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of logrotate config, rotated data, and write capability
evidence.summary: Confirmed /etc/logrotate.d/inventory config persisted, app.log.1.gz compressed archive intact, logrotate.timer active/enabled, and a new write to app.log succeeded after reboot
